Installation Desk Guidelines

1

On-site Surveys: Installation team must carry laser measurement tools and take high-resolution photos of site hurdles.

2

Safety Protocols: All team members attending height-based installations MUST utilize full-body safety harnesses.

3

Status Updates: Update the status immediately after coming back from site surveys to let design team start engineering drafts.

Design Desk Guidelines

1

Design Status updates: Design status will be updated by the Design Department to let team members track design progress.

2

Requirements: Ensure precise dimensions, preferred color palette, text copy, and any sample materials are provided upon request creation.

3

Approval Flow: Once completed, please coordinate with customer relationship manager to initiate client-side signoffs.
